# Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Unknown channel | Update with `pnpm add -g openclaw@latest` |
| Missing module | Run `pip install requests` first |

```bash
uv run --with moviepy --with pillow scripts/overlay.py
docker pull bringyour/community-provider:g4-latest
run-all.sh "docker pull bringyour/community-provider:g4-latest"
```
